free_tier.stated: No free tier. Every sandbox is paid at a flat USD 0.01 an hour for 2 vCPU and 4 GiB, billed by the second, with no plans, packs or minimums; a retired one-shot free test no longer starts anything.
free_tier.notes: The Attest one-shot and POST /v1/workers/free-test are retired and answer 410 workers_retired with billed:false; nothing starts and nothing is charged, so this is not a usable free tier. Credit is prepaid by card on Stripe or by a Bittensor coldkey.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not an object; 50 GB disk is included free at every size

retention.stated: Billing starts when the sandbox is booked and stops when it is deleted or reaches its stop time; one-shot runs ran once on a fresh machine, returned a result and were deleted, and a Worker's unused hold is refunded when it is deleted or expires.

egress.terms: A sandbox's egress policy is locked in Environment and hosts are allowed one at a time; no per-gigabyte transfer price or allowance is published on the pricing page.

interface_detail: A REST API under /v1 with a bearer API key, the ctcli client, a browser console and a line-mode terminal API; SSH into confidential sandboxes is not live yet.
tooling: the REST API, ctcli 0.6.1 or newer for offline receipt verification, and the console; a key with sandboxes:control creates and runs sandboxes
chaining: Paid confidential sandboxes with a signed receipt for every command, priced by the second and usable in fleets of up to 1,000 at once; receipts can be checked offline with a separately trusted public key, and the work can be paired with object storage for artifacts that outlive a sandbox.

limits.value: 1,000 confidential sandboxes at once and 600 starts per minute self-serve
a Worker lives at most 24 hours from start including renewals

limits_note: Billing starts when a sandbox is booked and stops when it is deleted or reaches its stop time; an agent key carries a budget and expiry and cannot add credit.
binding_note: The 1,000-concurrent-sandbox self-serve cap is the first hard ceiling at fleet scale; the per-hour rate is a price, not a quota, and the 24-hour Worker lifetime applies only to Workers.

identity_cost.detail: Account creation is email or Google: 'Email a one-time link or continue with Google. New here? That creates your account.' No phone or ID document is asked. Credit is prepaid: 'Choose a one-time pack. You pay by card on Stripe.' An alternative funds a Bittensor coldkey by burning TAO or spending Gamma. Agent keys come from a device login that a person approves with a budget and expiry; an agent cannot pay.

reliability_note: The earlier Attest one-shot and free test are retired with 410 workers_retired; rooms on one host share a host guest and are separated by gVisor, and the plaintext Worker form exposes the request and output to Cathedral's API.
confidence_note: The flat rate, the no-plans statement, the concurrency and start-rate limits, the retired free one-shot, and the email-or-Google sign-in with card-on-Stripe credit are quoted from Cathedral's own pricing, account, Workers and one-shot pages read on 2026-11-24.
